name: list_devices
description: List connected MIDI Captain pedals whose drive is mounted: volume name, path, model (std10, mini6, nano4, duo2, one1) and whether a config.json is present. A pedal in performance mode hides its drive and will not appear.

name: get_schema
description: Return the config JSON Schema, the reference for every field, its range and default. Pass `definition` for one part (e.g. ButtonConfig, KeytimesMessage, KeytimesEntry, EncoderConfig, PageControl, Page); omit it for the whole schema.

definition.description: Name of one schema definition. An unknown name returns the list of valid names.

name: get_config
description: Read a config. Returns the full config JSON, the device model, the page count and the number of buttons every page must have. Call this before changing anything.

target.description: Pedal drive path from list_devices, or the path of a saved config file. Omit to use the config open in the Config Editor, or the only connected pedal.

name: validate
description: Check a complete config without writing it. Returns ok, or the list of errors.

config.description: The complete config object, as returned by get_config.

name: apply_changes
description: Change a config: replace or append whole pages and/or set top-level fields. The merged config is validated first and nothing is written unless it is valid; on failure the errors are returned so you can correct and retry. Pages cannot be deleted or reordered.

pages.description: Pages to write. Each item replaces the page at `index` (0-based) with `page`; an index equal to the current page count appends a new page (20 pages at most).

page.description: A complete Page object: every button on the page, not only the ones that changed.

globals.description: Top-level config fields to set, e.g. global_channel, midi_thru_usb_to_din, page_control, display. A null value removes the field. `pages` is not allowed here.
